fields.default: IDEAS ARE EVERYWHERE. WE MAKE THEM *REAL.*
fields.instructions: Wrap words in *stars* to set them in red.

fields.label: Opening line
fields.default: We build products people keep and stories people remember.
was: More than creativity. Ideas are everywhere.

fields.name: manifesto_body
fields.label: Body
fields.default:
Having the idea is the easy part. Exploring it, building it and putting it in people's hands — that's the work, and it's the part we love.
Beautiful is where we start, not where we stop.
fields.instructions: One paragraph per line.
was:
What makes them valuable is how they are explored, developed, crafted, and experienced.
At KREATIVE STUDIO LAB, we believe creativity doesn't end with making something beautiful.

fields.name: manifesto_steps
fields.label: Steps
fields.default:
First, we listen | so we know what you actually need.
Then we play | sketch, test, break things on purpose.
Then we build it | with care, down to the last stitch.
And then it lives | the moment people pick it up.
fields.instructions: One step per line: the large words, then | then the rest.
was:
It begins | with understanding.
It grows | through experimentation.
It comes to life | through craftsmanship.
And it becomes meaningful | when people experience it.

fields.name: about_heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.instructions: Wrap words in *stars* to set them in red.

fields.name: about_body
fields.label: Body
fields.default:
We're a creative production studio. One side of the studio makes products; the other makes the photos, films and campaigns that make people want them.
We work with brands, companies, organisations and communities — from the first rough idea to the finished thing on the shelf, the screen or the street.
Most studios hand the making off to someone else. We don't. Creative and production sit in the same room here, and that's the whole point.
fields.instructions: One paragraph per line.
was:
KREATIVE STUDIO LAB is a Creative Production Studio specializing in Product Development and Creative Production.
We collaborate with brands, corporations, organizations, and communities to develop products, visual content, and brand experiences that create meaningful connections. By combining strategic thinking, creative exploration, and production expertise, we transform ideas into tangible experiences from the first concept to the final execution.
We don't separate creativity from production. We believe they belong together.

fields.name: pl_subhead
fields.label: Subheading
fields.default: Where ideas turn into things you can hold.

fields.name: pl_body
fields.label: Body
fields.default:
Got a product in your head? We'll get it into your hands. Materials, design, samples, production, finishing — we take it the whole way and sweat every stage.
Good products aren't lucky. They come from patience, obsessive detail and never settling for "close enough".
fields.instructions: One paragraph per line.
was:
We transform ideas into products that embody a brand's identity and purpose. From material exploration and design development to prototyping, production, and final finishing, every stage is approached with precision and intention.
We believe exceptional products are created through thoughtful craftsmanship, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to quality.

fields.instructions: Wrap words in *stars* to set them in red.

fields.name: cl_body
fields.label: Body
fields.default:
A great product still needs a reason to care. Creative Lab gives it one — photos, films and campaigns that make people feel something.
From the first idea to the final cut, we show what your product is and, more importantly, why it matters.
Because the best products are the ones people remember.
fields.instructions: One paragraph per line.
was:
Powerful products deserve meaningful stories. Through Creative Lab, we transform products into visual experiences that strengthen brand perception and create emotional connections.
From creative direction to campaign execution, we produce visual content that communicates not only what a product is, but why it matters.
Because every product deserves a story worth remembering.
